findings.description: sweep() calls transfer() without checking its returned bool. Because this contract accepts donations of arbitrary community-supplied tokens, this includes tokens that signal failure by returning false, or that (like older non-compliant ERC20s such as USDT) return no data at all.
evidence: function sweep(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
findings.recommendation: Verify the call succeeded and, if data was returned, that it decodes to true - without assuming every token follows the standard's return-value convention, since this sweeper must keep working for tokens that do not.

limitations: Off-chain logic, deployment configuration and key management were not assessed.
Operational security, infrastructure and tokenomics outside the analyzed code were not assessed.
Deployed contract state and third-party systems were not assessed.
